// A module that imports a bare specifier, so `importClosure`'s refusal for
// one can be driven by a test instead of asserted about.
//
// ITS EXTENSION IS `.ts.txt` AND NOT `.ts` ON PURPOSE. `tsconfig.json`
// includes `**/*.ts`, so a real `.ts` file importing a package that is not
// installed would fail `bun run typecheck` - a fixture breaking the build it
// is meant to protect. The walker reads a file's text and never its
// extension, so the `.txt` suffix changes nothing it does.
import { something } from "some-package"

export const used = something
